Here’s a polished rewrite of your email that keeps it professional, warm, and clear:  

---

**Subject:** Following Up on Med Spa Growth Opportunities  

Good Morning Melanie,  

I just wanted to follow up to see if you’re still interested in exploring ways we could support you and your sister with your med spas. I’d love the chance to connect and see if there are opportunities to help you grow and streamline things further.  

I also recently brought on a new team member who specializes in building local B2B partnerships for our clients. This includes securing referral relationships with gyms, photographers, and other complementary businesses. The best part is—she does all the legwork for you. All you have to do is meet the partners, shake hands, and start collaborating.  

Would you be open to a quick call next week to talk through possibilities?  

Best,  
[Your Name]  

---

Do you want me to make this version **more formal** (like a consulting proposal) or **more casual** (friendly, approachable outreach)?
